name: SS Coronary, Valve, Bypass and Circulatory Support Surgery

reference.source: ESC/EACTS myocardial revascularisation and valvular guidance, ACC/AHA valvular and coronary guidance, STS guidance, ESC endocarditis guidance, ISHLT transplant guidance and SYNTAX/FREEDOM/ART/PARTNER/COAPT trials (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Triple-vessel and left-main disease with high SYNTAX earns bypass by heart-team choice with LIMA to LAD and radial or second mammary added per ART debates. Severe aortic stenosis earns SAVR while high-risk earns TAVI per PARTNER, degenerative mitral earns repair and functional MR earns clips per COAPT, and infected valves earn urgent clearance per ESC guidance. Young earn mechanical prostheses with warfarin classes under ACC and AHA bands while cannulated bypass with cardioplegia and ECMO bridges failing hearts toward ISHLT transplant.
